concept_and_art_direction.core_concept: Elevating the legacy. Bass Crane is not just equipment; it's the backbone of Richmond's growth since 1913. The design will reflect this with heavy, structural typography, massive contrasting sections, and architectural layout rules.
concept_and_art_direction.color_mode: Dark mode primary (Industrial Charcoal/Black) with stark white and Signal Red accents for high tension and premium feel.

color_palette.primary_description: Crane Signal Red - Used for main CTA, progress bars, hover states. A loud, kinetic color.
color_palette.background_base_description: Deep Void Black - Base background for maximum contrast.
color_palette.background_surface_description: Industrial Charcoal - For cards, utility bar, header background.
color_palette.text_primary_description: Steel White - High contrast for headings and primary body.
color_palette.text_secondary_description: Muted Ash - For secondary descriptions, meta text.
color_palette.border_description: Subtle structural lines to divide sections without visual clutter.

headings.description: Used for all H1, H2, H3. Bold, wide, and industrial. Heavy weight contrast.

body.description: Technical, engineered sans-serif for body text. Perfect for the industrial aesthetic.

labels_and_mono.description: Used for utility bars, overlines, and placeholder labels.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Architectural grid. Massive whitespace (negative space) surrounding heavy objects.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento and Swiss column layouts. 12-column foundation. Subgrid for inner items.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius_description: Absolutely no rounded corners. Everything must be sharp, 90-degree angles to represent steel, engineering, and brutalism.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the premium Awwwards feel.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 'We Lift Richmond to New Heights'. Text is wrapped in a container with 'overflow: hidden', and the text itself animates from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with a slow ease-out (duration: 1.2s, stagger: 0.1s).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll on the massive gray placeholder images to give them depth.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: A slow, editorial marquee 'A FAMILY BUSINESS SINCE 1913 • WE LIFT RICHMOND TO NEW HEIGHTS •' running at 20% opacity in the background of the About section.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links feature a 'magnetic' pull or a stark color inversion (Black to Signal Red). Image placeholders scale down slightly (scale: 0.98) inside an overflow-hidden wrapper.

image_placeholders.rules: CRITICAL: NO STOCK PHOTOS. ALL photos must be gray placeholders.
image_placeholders.styling: Background: #1F1F1F. Border: 1px solid #333333. A 2px Signal Red inner border on hover.
image_placeholders.label: Inside the placeholder, bottom-left corner: A small #000000 box, padding p-2 px-4, text-xs uppercase IBM Plex Mono, text-white. E.g. 'PLACEHOLDER: CRANE LIFT ON RICHMOND JOBSITE'.
image_placeholders.treatment: Clipped frames. Add a pseudo-element or actual div with a 1px border that sits 10px off the image to create a 'blueprint / registration mark' effect.

buttons.primary: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Background: #E3000F. Text: #FAFAFA. Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-sm. Hover: Inverts to #FAFAFA background and #050505 text.
buttons.outline: Border: 1px solid #FAFAFA. Text: #FAFAFA. Background: transparent. Hover: Background #FAFAFA, text #050505.

cta_bands.style: Full width, high contrast. Background: #E3000F. Text: #050505. Massive typography ('CALL 24/7: 804-233-0113').

utility_bar.style: Height: 40px. Background: #121212. Text: #8B8D98, text-xs. Layout: Flex, space-between. Content: Phone, Email, Hours.

header.style: Sticky (z-50). Background: bg-[#050505]/90 backdrop-blur-xl. Border-bottom: 1px solid #2A2A2A. Padding: py-4.
header.nav: Desktop: Flex gap-8, IBM Plex Mono text-sm uppercase. Mobile: Hamburger menu opening a full-screen #050505 overlay.

Home.Hero: Massive typography masked reveal. 'We Lift Richmond to New Heights'. No background image, just stark text and a grid lines background pattern. A scroll indicator (vertical line growing).
Home.Since_1913: Large bold statement. Text size text-4xl md:text-6xl.
Home.Services_Grid: 6-card grid (Border collapse style). Each card has a line icon, bold title, and arrow on hover.
Home.Trust_Band: Marquee or grid of CCO Certified placeholder logos.
Home.Projects_Teaser: 2 large placeholder images side-by-side with parallax scrolling. 'Latest Lifts'.

Services.List: 6 detailed sections. Alternating layout (Left text/Right placeholder, Right text/Left placeholder). Each placeholder must have the premium architectural styling.

Projects.Gallery: CSS Grid (Masonry or irregular Bento). 6-9 labeled placeholder tiles. Hover effects on tiles.

Markets.Cards: 6 market cards in a 3-column grid. Dark cards with red accents.

About.Story: Editorial 2-column layout. Left: Sticky heading. Right: Flowing text with embedded historical placeholder photos.
About.Values: Row of 4 values (Safety First, Done Right, 3 Generations, 24/7). Divider lines between them.

Contact.Layout: 2-column split screen. Left: Contact info, huge 'Call Now' text, address, hours. Right: Form inside a #121212 box.
Contact.Form: Shadcn based. Square inputs, no rounded corners. Fields: First/Last, Email, Phone, Comment. Store to DB.
Contact.Map: Standard Google Map embed full width below the split section.

image_urls.description: Must be used exactly as-is in header and footer.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion and lenis (e.g. @studio-freight/react-lenis or just lenis) for animations and smooth scroll.
Do NOT use any real stock photos. You MUST use gray div elements specifically styled as described in components.image_placeholders.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
Ensure all components use `rounded-none` to fit the industrial aesthetic.
Implement the 'masked line-by-line reveal' in the Home Hero using framer-motion.
Apply 'Cabinet Grotesk' or fallback 'Anton' for Headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for Body, 'IBM Plex Mono' for labels.
Create the contact form storing to a simulated DB or API route.
Include a standard Google Maps iframe in the contact page.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (in this case, sharp edges) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
